Based on the Hermes Agent architecture, your memory remains fully under your control and decoupled from the underlying LLM provider in the following ways:

### 1. Model-Agnostic Local Storage
Memory in Hermes is stored locally on your machine/server, completely independent of the model provider. You can switch models at any time (via `/model` or `hermes chat -m <model>`) without losing context, as the memory layer is shared across all configured models.

### 2. Transparent, Plaintext Markdown Files
Hermes uses standard, portable Markdown files located in `~/.hermes/`, which you can directly view, edit, back up, or migrate to future tools:
- **`~/.hermes/USER.md`**: Stores your persistent user profile, concerns, goals, and personal preferences (`target="user"`).
- **`~/.hermes/MEMORY.md`**: Stores long-term global facts and knowledge learned over time.
- **`~/.hermes/SOUL.md`**: Defines the agent's persona and character.

### 3. Custom Memory Providers
If you want to design a custom memory architecture (e.g., custom databases, vector stores, or external sync services):
- You can build an external memory plugin implementing the `MemoryProvider` interface in `~/.hermes/plugins/`.
- Enable plugins using `hermes plugins enable <name>`.
